quest.title: Potions Most Potent
quest.description: Lisa seems to be busy with something... for once.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, cutie! To what do I owe the honor of your visit?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Are you here to peruse the library? Or, perhaps you're here to visit a certain someone...

choices.text: We're here to see you, of course.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, as considerate as ever, I see.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Alas, what rotten luck... You just so happen to have caught me in the middle of some important work. I'll have to treat you to afternoon tea some other time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're actually busy... with work? That's not a sight you see every day...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, you're right. The last time I was this consumed with research must have been way back at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I haven't done this much thinking for a long time. It's rather exhausting.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, if you're that interested, why don't you join in on the fun?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: What do you say? Want to help me relive my days as a scholar?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not polite to pawn off your work on other people, you know!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: #Is that a no then, {NICKNAME}? It would be quite the rare opportunity to work together... And you would, of course, be generously rewarded. But, if you don't want to...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As you probably know, the Knights of Favonius have long conducted research on alchemy.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But, most of that research has been carried out in a laboratory setting. The public's knowledge of alchemy is quite minimal.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Which means that up to this point, most of our research and discoveries have remained quite distant from people's daily lives. We've put a lot of Mora into the research, but have very little to show for our efforts.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Noting this disconnect, Jean decided to start an initiative where we'd share the fruits of our labor with the people. For now, that means introducing them to several different kinds of alchemical potions.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As it happens, I already have some experience with this work. Even though I usually work at the library, I have lent my support in the past to the management of the Knights' potion supply.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Potioneering was also one of my academic specializations back in the day, so Jean thought I was the best person for the job.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But, to create potions practical enough to support the daily needs of the people, a lot of adjustments had to be made to the ingredients we use, and the overall alchemical process also needed to be simplified...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All in all, what started as a relatively simple research project soon evolved into something exceedingly complicated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, are you asking us to help you with your research? 'Cause, uh, you're not exactly talking to two alchemy experts over here...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, no worries. I've already thought of the perfect job for you two.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Alchemical practices are becoming more and more advanced, but there's still a disconnect between our research and the general public. What we really need is to collect feedback from the people. Otherwise, we won't truly know if we're satisfying their needs.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But, if we want to conduct research and collect feedback at the same time, we need to go about things in a more efficient way.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: So, I thought the best way to do that would be to open up a potion shop! That way, we could continue to handle the alchemy side of things while also being able to interface with the public and understand their needs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! It's like killing two pigeons with one stone! Smart idea, Lisa!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: #Well, of course! And who better to take on this job than one of the most accomplished among our ranks... {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: When I was at the Akademiya, students would often help out with each other's research projects.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I'm sure my cuties wouldn't want to miss out on the opportunity to experience that sort of youthful enthusiasm for themselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... You make it sound nice and all, but Paimon still thinks you're just looking for a way to pawn off your work...

choices.text: We can just think of it as a favor for Lisa.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, I knew I could count on you!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: When all our work is done, I will personally see to it that you're generously rewarded.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All of the initial preparations have been made, so let's head to the shop. We'll finish our discussion after we get there.

choices.text: I'm always down for a bit of a challenge.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hah, I like your enthusiasm!

choices.text: Are you working on a research project?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: And decided to stop by for a chat along the way?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This is the shop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Looks like you've made a lot of preparations already! Did you do all this by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It was a group effort. A whole bunch of knights helped out.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Jean secured the initial funds to open the shop. Albedo and Sucrose provided the ingredients and equipment needed to brew the potions.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And the Logistics Company is handling the provision of all future supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Now with your help, it's like an additional weight has been lifted off my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The Knights have been busy spreading the word about our shop over the past few days. So, we should be ready to open once we've finished our final preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Okay, let's not keep everyone waiting, then. Why don't you take these ingredients and try your hand at brewing a potion?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: All you need to do is add the ingredients into the cauldron, follow the steps provided, and you're good to go.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ooh, seems like everything is going well. You've already sold your first batch of potions. Not a bad start at all.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: As for what potions you should brew next, we'll need to consult the news from the market.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: That means staying up to date on the latest news and trends to try and anticipate people's needs. It's an essential skill when it comes to business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, that sounds kinda hard...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe... Don't worry. I already took it upon myself to compile all the latest news on the market for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: What do you think? Have any ideas on the kinds of potions you should sell next?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Go ahead and try to cultivate some herbs then. Bio-alchemical processing can infuse herbs with different effects and properties.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Using different herbs in the brewing process will, in turn, alter the effects of the potion. There's a whole bunch of combinations to try.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Alright cutie, why don't you get started?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Go ahead and try to cultivate some herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: #Greetings, Honorary Knight! Greetings, Paimon! My name is Freda. I'm a knight from the Logistics Company. It's such an honor to meet the famous {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} loyal attendant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, Paimon's fame is really spreading across the land, hehe! One small correction though. Paimon's {M#his}{F#her} companion, not {M#his}{F#her} attendant!

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Ah, my apologies. I guess I got a bit carried away after hearing all about your exploits. It's just like something out of a novel!

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: You're practically legends at this point. I'm a bit jealous, actually...

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: I'd love to wander the land in search of adventure like one of those knights you read about in stories! Seems like a really fun life.

choices.text: Maybe you'll get the chance one day!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Yeah! That's what I'm hoping, at least!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Anyway, we've got some prep work to wrap up, right?

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: My orders from the Acting Grand Master are to support your business in any way I can.

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: If there's anything you need, just let me know!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: You're in luck! I just got a new batch of provisions! Please take a look and see if anything catches your eye!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Best of luck with your business!

choices.text: It's not actually all fun and games.

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: I bet. The knights in the stories are always running into all sorts of danger...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Seems like you've gotten the hang of the cultivation side of things.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, I should probably mention, a knight from the Logistics Company has arrived. She'll be the one handling the provision of all future supplies. You should go have a chat with her in a little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And after that, it'll be your time to shine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, what about you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Shouldn't it be our time to shine? Y'know, the three of us? What about your role in all this?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: My role? Naturally, it was to ensure my cuties had all the business and alchemy knowledge they needed to succeed!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll be rooting for you! Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew this would happen...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Why don't you put your potion on that shelf over there?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, you're finished already? Guess it's time to start advertising the grand opening of our shop! I'll tell the knights to start putting up the announcements right away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last visited the Knights of Favonius! Paimon wonders what Jean and Lisa have been up to recently. Let's go pay them a visit!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like you finished your potion! Now, all we need to do is put it on display for sale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we're done with all the prep work! Why don't we take a short break over there while we wait for customers to arrive?
